notes.subject: חרשו/חרשים
notes.rationale: Verb 'they ploughed' and noun 'ploughmen' share one root; Tok Pisin keeps 'holim hol'/'ol man bilong holim graun' to echo it.

notes.subject: plowing the back
notes.rationale: Image of a whip-scarred back likened to a ploughed field; rendered literally to keep the picture.

translation: Long bek bilong mi, ol man bilong holim graun i holim hol; ol i mekim ol lain hol bilong ol i go longpela.
